scene_target: Rhea exploits the party contract to bind the raw data packet as a 'Soul-Bound Liability' to prevent the system from deleting it.
goal: Secure the extracted data permanently before the system sweep deletes it.
conflict: The local system's automated sweep attempts to purge the unauthorized item from her standard inventory.
end_condition: The raw data packet is successfully bound as a Soul-Bound Liability in Rhea's unalterable inventory.
transition_in_text: Immediately following the terminal's purge, Rhea holds the raw data packet as the system attempts to reclaim it.
transition_out_text: The data is secured as a liability, safe from the local admin's reach.

invariants_add: inventory: rhea_mercer -> Raw Data Packet (status=stowed, container=system_inventory)

chapter_so_far_add: To prevent the system from deleting the evidence, Rhea bound the Raw Data Packet as a Soul-Bound Liability to the party, securing the proof of the Overseer's fraud.
key_events: The system initiated a Reclaim Purge to delete the Raw Data Packet.
Rhea accessed the Party Contract UI to exploit the Shared Debt and Liabilities clause.
Rhea flagged the Raw Data Packet as a Soul-Bound Liability under the Mutual Assured Destruction parameters.
Vance and Unit 734 confirmed the liability transfer.
The system accepted the liability, freezing the item's durability at 1%.
The Raw Data Packet was locked into Rhea's personal system inventory, safe from deletion.
last_scene: The terminal's automated sweep attempted to purge the Raw Data Packet from Rhea's inventory.
Rhea used the custom party contract to designate the data as a shared Soul-Bound Liability.
Vance and Unit 734 confirmed the override, locking the crystal safely into Rhea's unalterable system inventory.
The stolen administrative logs were secured from the local overseer's reach.
